summary: Stage 2 visual redesign (ChatWindow conversation view, steel tokens, new titanium cat logo) verified on feat/emergent-ui at http://127.0.0.1:3001/. Login (incl. key-restore), two-user live messaging (alice+bob via dual browser contexts), bubble styling, day divider, message actions menu, reply bar, in-conversation search, composer, drawer, and 390x844 + 1280x800 responsive layouts all PASS. critical_code_review_comments: Redesign constraint respected: ChatWindow.tsx changes are className/JSX-structure-only; all props, handlers (onSendText/onEdit/onDeleteForAll/onReply), E2E crypto paths (imageUrl/voiceUrl/downloadFilePayload), and composer state machine (messageComposerState) are untouched

LocatBrand.tsx logo is authored vector geometry with titanium gradient + steel-blue eyes/tail; both /icon-192.png and /icon-512.png return HTTP 200
Accessibility preserved: aria-labels on all icon buttons, send button exposes disabled reason ('Send unavailable: Write a message before sending.'), touch targets 44x44

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only visual redesign; Hono API embedded in Vite, exercised via login/messaging which all passed)

seed_data_creation: Sent 3 TEST_-prefixed text messages between alice_demo and bob_demo during testing (left in place; they are E2E-encrypted user data in the demo conversation)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh Playwright contexts have empty IndexedDB, so after login a 'Restore encrypted identity' screen appears — fill #restore-password with the same password and click 'Unlock keys'. Old messages do not sync to a new device context (relay queue already drained); to test incoming bubbles/online status/Read receipts, open a second browser context as bob_demo and exchange messages live. The send button's aria-label is 'Send' ONLY when the draft is non-empty; empty draft => 'Send unavailable: ...'. After clicking Copy in headless Chromium the menu stays open and shows 'Copy unavailable in this browser.' (expected). Console shows 2 benign pre-existing errors at t=0: 401 auth.me session probe and an AbortError; none after login. Vite dev server on port 3001 (3000 is an unrelated Expo process).

Composer textarea grows 60px->120px, steel-blue 44x44 rounded-full send button, attach/image/mic buttons present with intact tooltips. Mobile 390x844: back button visible and navigates to inbox, no header overlap, composer bottom at 831px <= 844, no horizontal overflow. Drawer shows new logo, Chats / Search conversations / People & requests / Storage & backups / privacy card / profile / Light-Dark toggle with no duplicated chat list.
